claude_proposed_widenings.name: context-gated passive roll modifier
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item fits the existing magic_item + passive family, and both grant_sense and modify_roll_advantage already exist, but the surface has no honest way to gate a passive Investigation advantage to examinations occurring within a 1-foot viewing range.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: granting you Darkvision within that range and Advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to examine something within that range
